title: Execution Clarity

symbolism: The Action Paradox represents the tension between overwhelming ambition and minimal incrementalism—Francisco must achieve clarity that execution flows from breaking unprecedented cosmic transformation into micro-actions with clear cues and progress tracking creating compounding momentum, not from grand gestures or insignificant steps.
